newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse closes little changed.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse closes little changed.

text.p: Ghana's stock exchange marked time on Monday, with investors cautious just over one month from presidential and parliamentary elections, traders said.
The GSE All-Share Index rose a mere 0.02 points to 367.57 from 367.55 points on Friday.
Pioneer Aluminium Factory, up 2 cedis to 153 cedis, was the lone riser.
A total of 28,410 shares were traded, down from 77,710 on Friday and 348,190 on Wednesday.
Offers stood at 1.07 million against demand of 191,710 shares.
Ghana holds national elections on December 7.
